newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian central bank sells 100 mln rbls VSM bonds.
newsitem.headline: Russian central bank sells 100 mln rbls VSM bonds.

text.p: The Russian central bank sold 100 million roubles nominal of VSM railway bonds on behalf of the company on Tuesday, the bank's open-market operations department said.
The bank made the following transactions:
The bank did not say at what price the paper was sold. The 22VSM03305 issue closed on Tuesday at 98.25 percent in secondary trade.
Apart from intervening on its own account for liquidity-smoothing and monetary policy purposes, the central bank buys and sells VSM bonds as part of its management of the VSM portfolio.
VSM is raising funds to build a high-speed railway between Moscow and St Petersburg. On Tuesday the company said it will make a fourth, 200 billion rouble bond issue in autumn.
